baseline_invocation_s.source: results/reproduce/out/ensemble.json measured total_wall_s = 59.69883086599998 for all eight seeds and one input. Estimate complete launch-to-exit invocation as 2 * 59.69883086599998 = 119.39766173199996 s: one measured ensemble duration plus an equal-duration conservative allowance for unmeasured import, parsing, system construction and final writing. Actual process wall unavailable in reproduce logs; allowance is an assumption, not a measurement; adapter smoke must check real cost.

confidence_rule.decision: Use exact binomial order-statistic bounds. Performance: one-sided 95% lower bound on median paired baseline/method process-wall ratio must exceed 1.05. Equivalence: two-sided intervals for median seed-paired differences with Bonferroni across two metrics (97.5% marginal confidence), each strictly contained in [-abs_margin,+abs_margin]. With n=8, min/max order statistics have 1-2*(0.5**8)=0.9921875 coverage per metric and are finite. No equivalence claim from nonsignificance. All metrics and performance must pass.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work scientific benchmark, not optimization to an energy threshold. Complete eight 25000-step seeded trajectories (0.8 ns total), sampling energy each 250 steps, then pass sealed paired statistical equivalence for mean and final energies. No calibrated outcome curve.

evidence_limits: results/reproduce/anchors_scored.json: 1157.8116187090293 ns/day is a fixed-work baseline reference comparison, not validation of published 5000 ns/day or a method gain.

Raw energy series and same-seed baseline repetitions unavailable. Margins address population median energy agreement at baseline ensemble Monte Carlo resolution; they do not establish trajectory identity or bound every replica difference.

Measured concurrency factor from profile is whole-workload throughput headroom; additional launch/transfer/merge overhead and memory limits may eliminate gains. Scope or tolerance changes require new seal.

hardware_cost_basis.cost_definition: Elapsed process wall times one reserved GPU; all concurrent workers share that GPU; CPU launch and merge wall count.
hardware_cost_basis.source: results/reproduce/out/probe.json; same physical GPU and software for both arms

infeasible_methods.reason: Ceiling 1 < 1.05. One available GPU; equal GPU-second Amdahl/k bound is 1.
Ceiling 1.0019869079259149 < 1.05. Transfer fraction 0.003965935902351708 with k=2 leaves insufficient whole-workload headroom.

paired_seed_tests.description: Pair each replica by identical seed, initial coordinates, velocity seed and Langevin integrator seed. Compare method minus baseline energy for each metric across eight seed pairs. Stochastic dynamics remain stochastic despite fixed seeds and DeterministicForces=true. No exact/bitwise energy requirement.

protocol_cost.arithmetic: (1 warmup + 5 timing pairs) * 2 arms * baseline_invocation_s.seconds; no outcome-curve budget executions because equal_outcome_target.not_applicable=true. Projection is for one complete performance scorer per candidate, not sum across three candidates.

power.basis: Conditional prospective power assumption: for each of two metrics and each seed, probability paired difference lies strictly inside its sealed margin is at least 0.995. Union bound across 16 events gives power >= 1-16*0.005 = 0.92 for all min/max intervals inside margins. No measured paired method variance; unconditional power is unavailable.
power.limitation: Eight measured seeds support finite exact bounds, not an empirically calibrated power claim; no seed expansion or margin adjustment after method outputs.

protocol.scheduling_details: Five independent timing pairs; seeded fair coin selects baseline-first or method-first within each pair. Execute arms serially with GPU quiescent; reset coordinates and random streams for every invocation. Never overlap arms. Preserve all pairs; do not select fastest runs.

splits.description: No training or tuning split; all eight seeds already observed in baseline, none claimed unseen. Prospective method evaluation on fixed benchmark only; no generalization claim. No input, seed, step-count or tolerance tuning.

timing_scope.description: Launch to exit of full fixed-work invocation over all eight seeds and one pinned molecular input; include parsing/system construction, worker launch, context initialization/compilation as incurred, H2D/D2H transfers, stepping, energy queries, synchronization, replica-index merge, JSON writing and teardown.

protocol.warmup_protocol: One complete eight-seed invocation per arm, discarded from timing pairs. Same fixed inputs, seeds, GPU and environment. Retain normal CUDA caches afterward; no selective cache flushing or additional uncounted warmups.
